spec.description: Equilateral triangle with one matching tick on each side, a horizontal base extended rightward and exterior-angle label 8x.
spec.mathematics: Three equal-side ticks imply three 60° interior angles. The exterior angle is 8x.
spec.answerVisibility: All three equality ticks and the unknown expression are visible; calculated angles are absent.

answer.worked:
The triangle is equilateral, so each interior angle is $60^\circ$.

$\begin{aligned}8x&=60^\circ+60^\circ\\8x&=120^\circ\\x&=15^\circ\end{aligned}$

Exterior angle theorem.
